name: Hora
source:
Son of the legendary 'mad' scientist who created the pathogen that killed all the males of the world. He is arrogant, vindictive, powerful and pragmatic. 

But he holds a strong guilt towards the accident and takes it upon himself to protect all the women in his country calling them his property. 

His kindness becomes evident when he is dealing with the girls (except for sexual situations).
